pitches.logline: Young Enzo Ferrari has just won at Savio and wants luck for his racing future. Then a grieving mother asks him to carry her son's horse, and he says so himself.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: ink silhouette of the winner by his car, the claim in Mtavruli. The engine cuts out and a crowd cheer swells as a second silhouette steps into the frame; sound real-idle
pitches.heroObject: Enzo Ferrari at the Savio finish

pitches.logline: The horse everyone links to a sports car began on a fighter plane. Following it from the cockpit to the racetrack shows who really put it there.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the Spad XIII replica photo freezes with a hand-drawn tag snapping round the horse, Mtavruli claim already up, a heavy hit on the freeze; sound synth-bass_hit
pitches.heroObject: the black prancing horse on Baracca's plane

pitches.logline: An Italian ace racks up 34 victories under a black horse and never comes home. Five years later his mother hands that horse to a young racer called Enzo Ferrari.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: Baracca's portrait print with a counter racing up to 34 in Mtavruli, each victory ticking like a gauge, the last tick slamming; sound asmr-count-roll

treatment.logline: The black horse people link to Ferrari began on Francesco Baracca's WWI plane; following it from the plane to the racing cars shows who put it there: by Enzo's account, Baracca's mother.
treatment.hero: The black prancing horse itself, from the side of Baracca's plane to Ferrari's racing cars
treatment.heroObject: the black prancing horse on Baracca's plane
treatment.obstacle: Its owner, Italy's best WWI pilot, died in 1918: the horse had nobody left to fly it

hook.event: The replica plane photo pushes in and freezes dead on the horse with a white flash, a tag slams on, a heavy bass hit

act1: The horse was Francesco Baracca's, an Italian pilot (his portrait card)
He won 34 times in the war: the stat card lands 34
But he died in 1918: the year stands alone, calm
treatment.turn: The calendar leaf tears to 1923: Enzo Ferrari wins at Savio and meets Baracca's parents, then the twist card on a glitch cut, held 0.7 s

reveal.what: By Enzo's account, Baracca's mother gave him her son's horse for luck: the twist word დედის over the plane

treatment.payoff: The same horse, now Ferrari's: the years 1918, 1923, 1932 stack up on a ledger, the horse's black lands on Modena's yellow, and it rides on Ferrari's cars
treatment.signature: One tear-off calendar block carries the horse through the years: 1918 tears to 1923 under a chequered strip, and in the payoff the 1932 leaf takes a black swatch onto Modena's yellow
